reference_implementation:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
services = json.loads(Path('config/services.json').read_text())
teams = json.loads(Path('config/teams.json').read_text())
result = {s: teams.get(t) for s, t in services.items()}
Path('reports').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('reports/service-owners.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
